_comment: Excerpt of `herdr api schema --json` (herdr CLI 0.9.3, server 0.9.1, protocol 22) limited to what internal/herdr uses. cli_requests are the exact socket requests the herdr 0.9.3 CLI sends, captured against a fake socket (HERDR_SOCKET_PATH); the CLI pings first, and `pane run` maps to pane.send_input with keys [Enter]. Live probes: pane.agent_status_changed subscriptions require pane_id; semantic errors echo the request id, invalid_request errors carry id "".

timeout_ms.description: Startup timeout in milliseconds. Values must be greater than 3000 and at most 300000.

oneOf.description: Outer popup size in terminal cells, including the border.
Outer popup size as a percentage of the terminal area, for example 80%.

source_workspace_id.description: Workspace whose focused pane supplies the `follow` cwd policy.

completion_seq.description: The current idle transition completed work, independently of who has viewed it.
